gloss: upstream; upper reaches of a river

definitions.gloss: upstream; upper reaches of a river
definitions.explanation: The part of a river closer to its source, or the direction from which the water flows.

definitions.gloss: upstream (in a supply chain or process)
definitions.explanation: The earlier stages of a production or supply chain, closer to raw materials or initial creation.

examples.japanese: {川上|かわかみ}から{流|なが}れてきた。
{川上|かわかみ}に{向|む}かって{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: I walked toward the upper reaches of the river.

examples.japanese: {大雨|おおあめ}で{川上|かわかみ}のダムが{放流|ほうりゅう}した。
examples.english: The dam upstream released water due to heavy rain.

examples.japanese: {川上|かわかみ}{産業|さんぎょう}から{川下|かわしも}{産業|さんぎょう}まで{一貫|いっかん}して{管理|かんり}する。
examples.english: To manage consistently from upstream industries to downstream industries.

examples.japanese: {製造|せいぞう}の{川上|かわかみ}で{品質|ひんしつ}を{管理|かんり}することが{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: It is important to control quality at the upstream stage of manufacturing.

examples.japanese: {川上|かわかみ}から{川下|かわしも}へ、{情報|じょうほう}が{正確|せいかく}に{伝|つた}わる{仕組|しく}みが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A system is needed for information to flow accurately from upstream to downstream.

notes:
The literal meaning refers to the upper part of a river, near its source. In business, {川上|かわかみ} and {川下|かわしも} are commonly used as a metaphor for stages in a supply chain or value chain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {川上|かわかみ}{産業|さんぎょう}: upstream industry (raw materials, manufacturing)
- {川上|かわかみ}から{川下|かわしも}まで: from upstream to downstream
- {川上|かわかみ}に{遡|さかのぼ}る: to go upstream; to trace back to the source

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {川下|かわしも}: downstream — the lower part of a river, or the later stages of a supply chain (distribution, retail)

RELATED WORDS:
- {上流|じょうりゅう}: upper stream — can be used similarly for rivers and also figuratively for upper class
- {源流|げんりゅう}: headwaters, source — the very origin of a river or tradition
